description: This file defines the ApplicationViewModel class for managing application state and UI modes in a calculator app, including view modes, window positioning, and command handling.

classes.name: ApplicationViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing application state, view modes, window positioning, and commands for a calculator app.

methods.name: ToggleAlwaysOnTop
methods.description: Toggles the calculator window between normal and compact overlay modes, saving size preferences.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the view model with a specified view mode, with fallback to standard mode on failure.

methods.name: RestoreFromSnapshot
methods.description: Restores application state from a saved snapshot.

methods.name: OnModeChanged
methods.description: Handles logic when the view mode changes, including initializing sub-viewmodels and logging.

methods.name: OnCopyCommand
methods.description: Executes copy command based on current view mode.

methods.name: OnPasteCommand
methods.description: Executes paste command based on current view mode.

methods.name: SetDisplayNormalAlwaysOnTopOption
methods.description: Sets whether the normal display mode supports the Always-on-Top option.

methods.name: TryRecoverFromNavigationModeFailure
methods.description: Attempts to recover from failure to navigate to a specific view mode by falling back to standard mode.

methods.name: RaisePropertyChanged
methods.description: Raises the PropertyChanged event for data binding updates.
